Results.ReviewText: I bought my first Webber charcoal grill in the 1960s, and used charcoal  with replacement Webbers for years.  I finally decided to try a Webber gas grill in 2001. This year (2022) my wife decided it was time for a new grill, that the old 2001 Webber was showing signs of its age.  I argued that it was a perfectly fine grill, never failed to ignite, and we used it regularly.  Sad to see my old grill go, but admitting that we both (me and my grill not my wife) were showing signs of age, we bought a new Webber Spirit II.  So I've starting on my next 20 year Webber grill adventure, with 15 grandchildren it gets a workout and is giving the same great performance.
Results.Title: 60 years of Webber grills

Results.ReviewText: I was able to grill twice and now the grill won't light.  I contacted Weber warranty and explained the issue.  They sent me information that I had already tried.  The next email from them they told me how to look for leaks.  I never said I had a leak.  I will be taking the grill back to the store.  First and last time I will buy a Weber.  I have been using gas grills for about 35 years and what I love about them is the ease of use.  Not too easy if it doesn't light.  I don't know if they use cheap regulators but there is a lot of information on the internet about people having the same problem.  They should have sent me a new regulator.  They caused me a lot of work for nothing.
Results.Title: Not a great grill and worse warranty service

Results.ReviewText: The lid is not designed well. Grease splatter drips down front of barbque onto ground from the lid and the back of the lid has a wide opening letting rain into the unit. grease does not turn to carbon on this style barbque. it just will drip onto your food and down the front. I always do a burnoff before and after I cook. With the new cooking grates it does not seem to get clean after a burnoff. Weber said try cooking my chicken at a lower temperature to reduce grease splatter. I will try this but if it doesn't work I may be throwing this barbque away and buying a different brand. very disappointed with this purchase. I had a genesys for 20 years before this and never had these problems with grease.
Results.Title: Poor Design

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
